title: Southern Breeze | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked away in the charming coastal community of Inlet Beach, Southern Breeze blends classic Southern charm with relaxed Gulf Coast luxury. This expansive three-story retreat offers over 4,300 square feet of beautifully designed living space, including five bedrooms, a private carriage house, and room for up to eighteen guests. Inside, inviting gathering spaces, a gourmet kitchen with premium appliances, and thoughtfully designed sleeping areas create the perfect setting for both lively family moments and quiet relaxation. Balconies and a rooftop terrace reveal sweeping Gulf views, while elegant interiors and comfortable furnishings elevate every stay.

Guests assume all risk for use of pools
